{{Color box|{{party color|Padayon Pilipino}}|border=darkgray}} [[Padayon Pilipino|PADAYN]] | blank2_name = Congressional bloc | blank2_info = Majority }} '''Cagayan de Oro's 1st congressional district''' is one of the two [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in [[Cagayan de Oro]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 2007.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 22, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} It was created by the 2007 [[reapportionment]] that divided the city into two congressional districts and which took effect in the same year.{{cite web|url=http://lawyerly.ph/laws/view/lfd1 |title=Republic Act No. 9371, (2007-02-22) |publisher=Lawyerly |accessdate=February 22, 2021}} The district is composed of all [[barangay]]s located west of the [[Cagayan River (Mindanao)|Cagayan River]] and includes the city's southern barangays bordering the mountains of [[Talakag]] and [[Iligan]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Lordan Suan]] of the [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas]] (PFP) and [[Padayon Pilipino]] (PADAYN).{{cite web|url=https://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 12, 2023}}{{cite news|url=https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/11/21/23/pdp-laban-loses-more-congressmen-to-lakas-cmd|title=Duterte's PDP-Laban loses more congressmen to Romualdez' Lakas-CMD|first=RG|last=Cruz|work=ABS-CBN News|date=November 21, 2023|access-date=November 21, 2023}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
